hero._why_at: In the catalogue stand's view corridor (stand -240, 4463.6 heading 92): at the seat itself (-150) the grove hid it from 90 m. r28 sat it at (-180, 4492), where its thin end lay across deepwood_road's north leg ((-150, 4460) -> (-310, 5050)); moved 25 m west so every collider box keeps at least 11 m from both road legs and 13 m from road_visibility_deepwood_road_09 (tests/test_stormwood_fallen_giant_collider.gd).
hero._why_collider: Coordinator (26 Oct): a 55 m log with no collider and its grove cleared would be walked straight through. Seven boxes [centre x, y, z, size x, y, z] in the holder frame, one per 7.9 m slice of the fitted GLB's own vertices (85% of each slice's width, 90% of its height so silhouette edges do not block air): trunk, root plate and the low splayed roots. The hollow root mouth is blocked deliberately (no interior). Built on every shell, a headless host included (no mesh read at runtime); footprint_half_m is the fitted GLB's half width/length for seating.

fallen_giant._geometry: One intact installed tree, uniform scale. Axial roll precedes fall rotation; pitch is selected against shipping Terrain3D mesh samples. Both root and crown must seat within the support tolerance; otherwise no candidate is mounted. No grounding rocks needed when the tree has two terrain supports.
fallen_giant._reference: Stormwood Stormheart boards A/B: coherent installed wood/stone, monumental natural silhouette. CPU installed mesh inspection and revised full-footprint audit accompany the candidate; the earlier flat draft lift and distant placement are superseded. Original Bark_DeadTree materials and asset provenance retained.
